headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rates and Hormuz risks sustain high Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend, so no fresh continuation, failed-retracement, or session-extreme evidence can form. Friday ended with U.S. equities lower after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight, while Iran said Hormuz restrictions would continue. Those factors sustain Stress without establishing a current pathological price path.
